label: PF Backlog 583
title: Merge driver path drifts to a dead worktree -> derived-file conflicts not auto-resolved
body: merge.pf-derived.driver was configured with an absolute path into a removed worktree (product-forge-worktrees/prepush-tests/product-forge/scripts/dev/pf_merge_driver.py), so the pf-derived driver never ran; docs/BACKLOG-SUMMARY.md and docs/documentation-index.html conflicted on merge and had to be regenerated by hand. Fix: install_hooks.py must (re)write the driver path to the current clone at hook-install/sync time, and a check should assert the driver path resolves.
